articles.title_en: Analýza výsledků voleb v USA: Může nový Kongres zastavit Trumpovy vojenské operace?

articles.title_en: More Czechs turning to AI for health advice; doctors warn against relying on chatbots
articles.lead_en: More people in Czechia are turning to artificial intelligence for health advice, including mental health support.
